bullets.text: Researching and implementing Java-based utilization optimizations for Amazon Redshift

Overhauled the legacy UI of a test data workflow creator using React.js + Electron with TypeScript-aided workflow and state validation backed by Jest testing on mock workflows and improved editor fluidity via React-Flow, receiving an internal satisfaction report of 90% compared to the legacy tool

Engineered a lightweight tree-style workflow search index to minimize database queries under access constraints, implementing a Python + SQLAlchemy pipeline that distilled popular workflows from a 270,000+ row PostgreSQL table into a precomputed search index, backed by Redis caching for full workflow retrieval and abstraction through a Node.js IPC module

Developed a Claude skill for workflow generation, constraining open-ended model search via sub-skill decomposition and Python functions for workflow search and validation, and used AWS CloudWatch + OpenSearch latency logging to locate bottlenecks, cutting generation time 65% from previous tooling to under 15 seconds

Deployed an Amazon Leo space topic research utility adopted into Leo's ecosystem through Docker + AWS Fargate orchestration and GitHub Actions CI/CD, with AWS CDK (TypeScript)-defined infrastructure to allow contribution from non-familiar engineers

Achieved a 34% speedup on a pipeline routing 6,000+ scraped research documents for inference by implementing Kinesis streams feeding Lambda processors handling data processing and redirection, with Lambda + API Gateway fronting for app integration

Integrated automated fine-tuning of an AWS Bedrock source relevancy inference model through AWS EventBridge cron triggers with decision gates to avoid redundant retraining, with CloudWatch + X-Ray application tracing for automated performance monitoring and metric-based SNS notifications to engineers on application failure
Developing automated training for PhysTwin, a physics-based digital twin, with a PhD research team targeting an ICLR submission

Built a Python pipeline linking AnyGrasp multi-camera grasp candidates to Open3D-rendered overlay views consumed by a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-FP8 VLM, enabling researchers to develop changes faster through isolating scene components

Cut research-environment setup time 30% via UV dependency pinning and Docker for ensuring identical setup, with psutil-based timing and memory monitoring across runtime and Pytest unit testing for quickly identifying bottlenecks
Co-founded and scaled a 110+ member campus product studio shipping 5 live products, utilizing Jira task management and GitHub code management to organize teams through agile practices

Sustained 20,000+ site visits within the initial 30-day launch period of Tortuga, an enhanced class scheduler, through developing Prisma-based SQL querying with Redis query caching to reduce database load and application latency

Building a work-in-progress integration of a RAG meal suggestion into the official UMD app using GPT-4o mini over ChromaDB + SentenceBERT vector search on scraped recipe data, achieving 93% generated meal satisfaction on internal test users
Implemented a C++-based order book simulation on historical IEX data, with a contract-based plug-and-play design to allow for evaluating multiple approaches with enforced correctness

Wrote and evaluated paginated hash-based data storage for live order book data with in-memory LFU caching for frequently requested tickers during simulation, evaluated for drift against IEX's historical book data

Designed and assessed the performance of a time-based Adaptive LSM storage against a B+ tree storage for logs during simulation, testing for throughput and latency via rdtscp-based timing and hardware utilization via Linux's perf performance counter
